items.title: 66095_Benny Carter oral history interview
items.q: I was doing a thing with a friend of mine, Herman Herbert Stein

ctx.x: Uh huh. How did that start?

Well, I was doing a thing with a friend of mine, Herman Herbert Stein, who was a composer at Universal Studios. He and Mancini had worked together quite a lot. We were working on a film ... I think it was, oh, what was it -- it must have been an M Squad (PROTOTYPE); it was a segment of something, and he had me over to do some solo saxophone bit in it.
That was the film, "M Squad" -- is that what you were saying?
